transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Before we close the curriculum agenda today, I'd like to follow our usual practice. Could the department chair and the college liaison please report any remaining requirements for the environmental science dual-credit course proposal? I want to make sure we've addressed everything before I make a final decision on authorization.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to report a remaining requirement for this proposal. During my department staffing review this week, I confirmed that the proposed instructor does not hold the credential required to teach a dual-credit science course. Under district dual-credit rules, authorization is permitted only if a credentialed science co-teacher is assigned to every class meeting. I have not yet amended the proposal to reflect this requirement, so this is an outstanding item that needs to be addressed before final authorization.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I also need to report a remaining requirement. When I verified the college records this week, I found that our signed articulation agreement classifies environmental science as a 3-credit course requiring 2 laboratory contact hours per week. However, the school's current proposal describes it as a 2-credit seminar with only 1 laboratory contact hour per week. I have not yet updated the proposal to align with the articulation agreement, so this credit-hour and lab-hour discrepancy is an outstanding item that must be resolved before final authorization.
